findings.problem: distribute() multiplied total * weight in 64-bit ints, which overflows for large amounts in currencies with many units (e.g. Rp 50,000,000 split by 2), giving wrong balances.
findings.fix: Same-currency fast path and BigInt multiplication.

findings.problem: Restore accepted trips with fewer than 2 people, non-positive amounts, bad rate dates and splits that don't add up, which later crash the forms.
findings.fix: Backup.decode rejects such files as not a Trippi backup.

findings.problem: Launch steps (Premium re-check, consent and ads, rates) did not run after 'Try again' on a load error, and ads never started when Premium lapsed mid-session.
findings.fix: Launch steps run on any successful load; ads start whenever the user becomes free.

findings.problem: Unawaited setPremium/refresh calls could raise unhandled errors on a failed write.
findings.fix: setPremium keeps the in-memory status and swallows a failed write; unawaited calls have catchError.

findings.problem: Category save had no error handling and a double tap could create duplicates.
A failed expense delete threw out of confirmDismiss with no feedback.
findings.fix: try/catch with a snackbar; the row stays.
